title: Host memory observation
responsibility: Parses macOS or Linux memory counters, or reads Windows host totals, and returns total, available, and pressure facts; unsupported or invalid sources fail.

inputs.name: macMemory.text
inputs.description: Output of vm_stat in the expected page-counter format.

inputs.name: macMemory.pressure
inputs.description: kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level output; values 1, 2 and 4 map to normal, warning and critical, other values map to unknown.

inputs.name: macMemory.total
inputs.description: Host physical-memory total in bytes, used to cap available-page bytes.

inputs.name: linuxMemory.text
inputs.description: /proc/meminfo text containing MemTotal and MemAvailable in kB.

outputs.name: macMemory
outputs.description: Total and available bytes plus mapped pressure; available pages are capped by total physical memory.

outputs.name: linuxMemory
outputs.description: Total and available bytes, with critical pressure only below five percent available and normal pressure otherwise.

outputs.name: hostMemory
outputs.description: Platform observation using vm_stat/sysctl on macOS, /proc/meminfo on Linux, or OS memory values on Windows.

errors.name: Invalid memory counters
errors.description: macMemory and linuxMemory reject when platform counters cannot be parsed or totals are not positive

errors.name: Unsupported resource platform
errors.description: hostMemory rejects platforms other than macOS, Linux and Windows

errors.name: Memory probe failure
errors.description: macOS tool execution and Linux /proc/meminfo read failures reject to the caller
